retrievalProfile.description: A dramatic low-angle portrait featuring a subject with a gold crown of thorns and high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting paired with heavy blackletter and wide-tracked sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: gold crown of thorns hip hop cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, low-angle close-up of a bearded man looking upward, wearing a metallic gold crown of thorns. The lighting is high-contrast, casting deep shadows on one side of the face while highlighting the texture of the skin and the metallic sheen of the crown against a dark, near-black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed toward the upper right corner
Gold crown of thorns as the primary symbolic anchor
Typography positioned in the center-left negative space
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the central and right two-thirds of the frame in a tight headshot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The gold crown of thorns at the top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright crown, follows the subject's upward gaze, then drops to the typography on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark negative space on the left side and background to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold for the crown and jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, ornate blackletter strokes with sharp terminals.
Secondary text uses wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
Text is rendered with a slight distressed or textured finish.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'i' in the display text is topped with a small cross symbol.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the dark negative space of the subject's shoulder/neck area.
Aligned with the start of the display text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate historical blackletter contrasted with modern, airy geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, ornate blackletter feel.
Provides the clean, geometric contrast for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, low-angle portrait of a man with a beard looking up, wearing a detailed gold crown of thorns. Use chiaroscuro lighting against a black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large blackletter title in the center-left area, with a wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle directly beneath it in off-white.

verificationChecks: Is the crown of thorns metallic gold?
Is the subject looking upward at an angle?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep shadows?
Is the secondary text widely tracked?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clear metallic texture on the crown

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the crown of thorns looks like physical gold jewelry.
Verify the upward gaze creates a sense of reverence or aspiration.
Check that the typography does not obscure the main facial features.
Confirm the chiaroscuro effect maintains detail in the highlights.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle portrait + Gold Crown of Thorns + Chiaroscuro Lighting + Blackletter/Sans-Serif Pairing
